# Fixed-schedule MTP first-entry reuse and GDN recording serving qualification

Frozen V51 runs seven alternating rounds and three arms: reference, first-entry reuse alone, and GDN recording alone. Every arm has the same 10 GB target, loaded MTP head, fixed depth one, compact state/MTP rows, bounded tails, 256-token prefill setting, seventeen-token raw fixture and sixteen greedy outputs. The timing-driven adaptive path is disabled in every arm. One full request warms each fresh server before its measured request; prefix reuse is off. No workspace shell commands run during the measurement block.

All twenty-one cells pass the resource gates and each candidate has seven exact-ID/exact-text pairs with no exclusions. First-entry median client reduction is 0.0432633361%; recording reduction is 0.1919424546%. Both fail the frozen five-percent gain and eighty-percent-positive gates. This workload establishes exact serving parity, but no material request speedup; the controls remain off. Existing component/state correctness evidence is preserved independently. These results do not establish combined gains, high-residency behavior, or the completion of OPT23/24.

```
slotstream memory plan (--memory-gb)
  device: 52 GB RAM (23.2 GB reclaimable now), 40.2 GB Metal working set
  target: 10.0 GB total for this process
  cache:  ~13 of 512 experts per layer  (640 global slots = 1.8 GB pool)
  expect: ~9.6 GB peak, ~3 tok/s warm decode (est. from M5 Pro anchors)
  disk:   that estimate assumes an SSD like the one it was measured on (17.3 GB/s). A base-storage Mac mini M2 reads 1.5 GB/s and decoded at 1.41 tok/s against a ~4 estimate, so on base storage expect well under the number above — see docs/HARDWARE.md
  prefill: 256 tokens per pass (~85 tok/s here; costs ~0.3 GB of the target)
  mtp:    draft head on — speculative decode (1.6 GB resident, charged above)
  vision: images accepted — first image reserves +0.9 GB inside the target; refused if it cannot fit
  context: up to 32768 tokens per request (prompt + reply); a full-length prompt takes ~6.4 min before its first token here, follow-up turns read only what is new
  reuse:  up to 7595 tokens across 4 conversations (~0.5 GB), so a follow-up turn re-prefills only what is new
engine ready in 0.7s: expert cache ~13/512 per layer (640 global slots = 1.8 GB), mtp draft head on, eos [248044, 248046]
prefix cache: off — every request re-prefills its whole prompt

```

slotstream memory plan (--memory-gb)
  device: 52 GB RAM (23.1 GB reclaimable now), 40.2 GB Metal working set
  target: 10.0 GB total for this process
  cache:  ~13 of 512 experts per layer  (640 global slots = 1.8 GB pool)
  expect: ~9.6 GB peak, ~3 tok/s warm decode (est. from M5 Pro anchors)
  disk:   that estimate assumes an SSD like the one it was measured on (17.3 GB/s). A base-storage Mac mini M2 reads 1.5 GB/s and decoded at 1.41 tok/s against a ~4 estimate, so on base storage expect well under the number above — see docs/HARDWARE.md
  prefill: 256 tokens per pass (~85 tok/s here; costs ~0.3 GB of the target)
  mtp:    draft head on — speculative decode (1.6 GB resident, charged above)
  vision: images accepted — first image reserves +0.9 GB inside the target; refused if it cannot fit
  context: up to 32768 tokens per request (prompt + reply); a full-length prompt takes ~6.4 min before its first token here, follow-up turns read only what is new
  reuse:  up to 7595 tokens across 4 conversations (~0.5 GB), so a follow-up turn re-prefills only what is new
engine ready in 0.7s: expert cache ~13/512 per layer (640 global slots = 1.8 GB), mtp draft head on, eos [248044, 248046]
prefix cache: off — every request re-prefills its whole prompt

```

slotstream memory plan (--memory-gb)
  device: 52 GB RAM (23.5 GB reclaimable now), 40.2 GB Metal working set
  target: 10.0 GB total for this process
  cache:  ~13 of 512 experts per layer  (640 global slots = 1.8 GB pool)
  expect: ~9.6 GB peak, ~3 tok/s warm decode (est. from M5 Pro anchors)
  disk:   that estimate assumes an SSD like the one it was measured on (17.3 GB/s). A base-storage Mac mini M2 reads 1.5 GB/s and decoded at 1.41 tok/s against a ~4 estimate, so on base storage expect well under the number above — see docs/HARDWARE.md
  prefill: 256 tokens per pass (~85 tok/s here; costs ~0.3 GB of the target)
  mtp:    draft head on — speculative decode (1.6 GB resident, charged above)
  vision: images accepted — first image reserves +0.9 GB inside the target; refused if it cannot fit
  context: up to 32768 tokens per request (prompt + reply); a full-length prompt takes ~6.4 min before its first token here, follow-up turns read only what is new
  reuse:  up to 7595 tokens across 4 conversations (~0.5 GB), so a follow-up turn re-prefills only what is new
engine ready in 0.7s: expert cache ~13/512 per layer (640 global slots = 1.8 GB), mtp draft head on, eos [248044, 248046]
prefix cache: off — every request re-prefills its whole prompt

```

```
slotstream memory plan (--memory-gb)
  device: 52 GB RAM (23.2 GB reclaimable now), 40.2 GB Metal working set
  target: 10.0 GB total for this process
  cache:  ~13 of 512 experts per layer  (640 global slots = 1.8 GB pool)
  expect: ~9.6 GB peak, ~3 tok/s warm decode (est. from M5 Pro anchors)
  disk:   that estimate assumes an SSD like the one it was measured on (17.3 GB/s). A base-storage Mac mini M2 reads 1.5 GB/s and decoded at 1.41 tok/s against a ~4 estimate, so on base storage expect well under the number above — see docs/HARDWARE.md
  prefill: 256 tokens per pass (~85 tok/s here; costs ~0.3 GB of the target)
  mtp:    draft head on — speculative decode (1.6 GB resident, charged above)
  vision: images accepted — first image reserves +0.9 GB inside the target; refused if it cannot fit
  context: up to 32768 tokens per request (prompt + reply); a full-length prompt takes ~6.4 min before its first token here, follow-up turns read only what is new
  reuse:  up to 7595 tokens across 4 conversations (~0.5 GB), so a follow-up turn re-prefills only what is new
engine ready in 0.7s: expert cache ~13/512 per layer (640 global slots = 1.8 GB), mtp draft head on, eos [248044, 248046]
prefix cache: off — every request re-prefills its whole prompt

```

slotstream memory plan (--memory-gb)
  device: 52 GB RAM (23.5 GB reclaimable now), 40.2 GB Metal working set
  target: 10.0 GB total for this process
  cache:  ~13 of 512 experts per layer  (640 global slots = 1.8 GB pool)
  expect: ~9.6 GB peak, ~3 tok/s warm decode (est. from M5 Pro anchors)
  disk:   that estimate assumes an SSD like the one it was measured on (17.3 GB/s). A base-storage Mac mini M2 reads 1.5 GB/s and decoded at 1.41 tok/s against a ~4 estimate, so on base storage expect well under the number above — see docs/HARDWARE.md
  prefill: 256 tokens per pass (~85 tok/s here; costs ~0.3 GB of the target)
  mtp:    draft head on — speculative decode (1.6 GB resident, charged above)
  vision: images accepted — first image reserves +0.9 GB inside the target; refused if it cannot fit
  context: up to 32768 tokens per request (prompt + reply); a full-length prompt takes ~6.4 min before its first token here, follow-up turns read only what is new
  reuse:  up to 7595 tokens across 4 conversations (~0.5 GB), so a follow-up turn re-prefills only what is new
engine ready in 0.7s: expert cache ~13/512 per layer (640 global slots = 1.8 GB), mtp draft head on, eos [248044, 248046]
prefix cache: off — every request re-prefills its whole prompt

```

slotstream memory plan (--memory-gb)
  device: 52 GB RAM (23.4 GB reclaimable now), 40.2 GB Metal working set
  target: 10.0 GB total for this process
  cache:  ~13 of 512 experts per layer  (640 global slots = 1.8 GB pool)
  expect: ~9.6 GB peak, ~3 tok/s warm decode (est. from M5 Pro anchors)
  disk:   that estimate assumes an SSD like the one it was measured on (17.3 GB/s). A base-storage Mac mini M2 reads 1.5 GB/s and decoded at 1.41 tok/s against a ~4 estimate, so on base storage expect well under the number above — see docs/HARDWARE.md
  prefill: 256 tokens per pass (~85 tok/s here; costs ~0.3 GB of the target)
  mtp:    draft head on — speculative decode (1.6 GB resident, charged above)
  vision: images accepted — first image reserves +0.9 GB inside the target; refused if it cannot fit
  context: up to 32768 tokens per request (prompt + reply); a full-length prompt takes ~6.4 min before its first token here, follow-up turns read only what is new
  reuse:  up to 7595 tokens across 4 conversations (~0.5 GB), so a follow-up turn re-prefills only what is new
engine ready in 0.7s: expert cache ~13/512 per layer (640 global slots = 1.8 GB), mtp draft head on, eos [248044, 248046]
prefix cache: off — every request re-prefills its whole prompt

```

slotstream memory plan (--memory-gb)
  device: 52 GB RAM (23.4 GB reclaimable now), 40.2 GB Metal working set
  target: 10.0 GB total for this process
  cache:  ~13 of 512 experts per layer  (640 global slots = 1.8 GB pool)
  expect: ~9.6 GB peak, ~3 tok/s warm decode (est. from M5 Pro anchors)
  disk:   that estimate assumes an SSD like the one it was measured on (17.3 GB/s). A base-storage Mac mini M2 reads 1.5 GB/s and decoded at 1.41 tok/s against a ~4 estimate, so on base storage expect well under the number above — see docs/HARDWARE.md
  prefill: 256 tokens per pass (~85 tok/s here; costs ~0.3 GB of the target)
  mtp:    draft head on — speculative decode (1.6 GB resident, charged above)
  vision: images accepted — first image reserves +0.9 GB inside the target; refused if it cannot fit
  context: up to 32768 tokens per request (prompt + reply); a full-length prompt takes ~6.4 min before its first token here, follow-up turns read only what is new
  reuse:  up to 7595 tokens across 4 conversations (~0.5 GB), so a follow-up turn re-prefills only what is new
engine ready in 0.7s: expert cache ~13/512 per layer (640 global slots = 1.8 GB), mtp draft head on, eos [248044, 248046]
prefix cache: off — every request re-prefills its whole prompt

```

slotstream memory plan (--memory-gb)
  device: 52 GB RAM (23.6 GB reclaimable now), 40.2 GB Metal working set
  target: 10.0 GB total for this process
  cache:  ~13 of 512 experts per layer  (640 global slots = 1.8 GB pool)
  expect: ~9.6 GB peak, ~3 tok/s warm decode (est. from M5 Pro anchors)
  disk:   that estimate assumes an SSD like the one it was measured on (17.3 GB/s). A base-storage Mac mini M2 reads 1.5 GB/s and decoded at 1.41 tok/s against a ~4 estimate, so on base storage expect well under the number above — see docs/HARDWARE.md
  prefill: 256 tokens per pass (~85 tok/s here; costs ~0.3 GB of the target)
  mtp:    draft head on — speculative decode (1.6 GB resident, charged above)
  vision: images accepted — first image reserves +0.9 GB inside the target; refused if it cannot fit
  context: up to 32768 tokens per request (prompt + reply); a full-length prompt takes ~6.4 min before its first token here, follow-up turns read only what is new
  reuse:  up to 7595 tokens across 4 conversations (~0.5 GB), so a follow-up turn re-prefills only what is new
engine ready in 0.7s: expert cache ~13/512 per layer (640 global slots = 1.8 GB), mtp draft head on, eos [248044, 248046]
prefix cache: off — every request re-prefills its whole prompt

```

slotstream memory plan (--memory-gb)
  device: 52 GB RAM (23.6 GB reclaimable now), 40.2 GB Metal working set
  target: 10.0 GB total for this process
  cache:  ~13 of 512 experts per layer  (640 global slots = 1.8 GB pool)
  expect: ~9.6 GB peak, ~3 tok/s warm decode (est. from M5 Pro anchors)
  disk:   that estimate assumes an SSD like the one it was measured on (17.3 GB/s). A base-storage Mac mini M2 reads 1.5 GB/s and decoded at 1.41 tok/s against a ~4 estimate, so on base storage expect well under the number above — see docs/HARDWARE.md
  prefill: 256 tokens per pass (~85 tok/s here; costs ~0.3 GB of the target)
  mtp:    draft head on — speculative decode (1.6 GB resident, charged above)
  vision: images accepted — first image reserves +0.9 GB inside the target; refused if it cannot fit
  context: up to 32768 tokens per request (prompt + reply); a full-length prompt takes ~6.4 min before its first token here, follow-up turns read only what is new
  reuse:  up to 7595 tokens across 4 conversations (~0.5 GB), so a follow-up turn re-prefills only what is new
engine ready in 0.7s: expert cache ~13/512 per layer (640 global slots = 1.8 GB), mtp draft head on, eos [248044, 248046]
prefix cache: off — every request re-prefills its whole prompt

```

slotstream memory plan (--memory-gb)
  device: 52 GB RAM (23.4 GB reclaimable now), 40.2 GB Metal working set
  target: 10.0 GB total for this process
  cache:  ~13 of 512 experts per layer  (640 global slots = 1.8 GB pool)
  expect: ~9.6 GB peak, ~3 tok/s warm decode (est. from M5 Pro anchors)
  disk:   that estimate assumes an SSD like the one it was measured on (17.3 GB/s). A base-storage Mac mini M2 reads 1.5 GB/s and decoded at 1.41 tok/s against a ~4 estimate, so on base storage expect well under the number above — see docs/HARDWARE.md
  prefill: 256 tokens per pass (~85 tok/s here; costs ~0.3 GB of the target)
  mtp:    draft head on — speculative decode (1.6 GB resident, charged above)
  vision: images accepted — first image reserves +0.9 GB inside the target; refused if it cannot fit
  context: up to 32768 tokens per request (prompt + reply); a full-length prompt takes ~6.4 min before its first token here, follow-up turns read only what is new
  reuse:  up to 7595 tokens across 4 conversations (~0.5 GB), so a follow-up turn re-prefills only what is new
engine ready in 0.7s: expert cache ~13/512 per layer (640 global slots = 1.8 GB), mtp draft head on, eos [248044, 248046]
prefix cache: off — every request re-prefills its whole prompt

```

  reuse:  up to 7595 tokens across 4 conversations (~0.5 GB), so a follow-up turn re-prefills only what is new
engine ready in 0.7s: expert cache ~13/512 per layer (640 global slots = 1.8 GB), mtp draft head on, eos [248044, 248046]
prefix cache: off — every request re-prefills its whole prompt
